description: Which gates block a merge in this repository, and which are reported but cannot block here. The distinction is stated rather than hidden, because a harness that quietly downgrades its own controls is worth nothing.

advisory.human-approval: GitHub does not let the author of a pull request approve it, and this demonstration repository has one maintainer. In an organisation this gate is a branch protection rule with required reviewers, not a script: the platform enforces it and no workflow can bypass it. It is reported here so the receipt still records that it was owed.
